This is a debug build. A signed production release cannot be installed through this updater. Review the release page and export settings before changing signing keys.

Import replaces existing settings, bookmarks and favorites, clears saved page history and restarts this screen. Unsaved page text may be lost. Imported files cannot grant microphone or camera consent. Continue?
All 100 library entries are pinned. Unpin or delete one before adding another.
Apply appearance and reopen this screen? Unsaved page text may be lost. Web content keeps its own appearance.

Prepare a lorebook locally from structured TXT, JSON or PNG/CHARX character-card metadata (up to 2 million text characters). Export a file or copy text, then use Create → Lorebook → Import in Character.AI. Service access, linking and publishing depend on your account.
Some source fields or trigger rules are not supported by the target format. The original file is unchanged.
Replace the current unsaved draft? Save a local copy or export it first if you want to keep it.
Could not import this file. Check UTF-8 encoding, supported format and size limits. Existing preview was kept.
Loaded locally. Tap an entry to review it.

Review missing titles, content or keywords, entries with more than eight keywords, and unsupported source settings. Disabled entries are omitted. JSON names and descriptions may need to be entered in the official editor. Export anyway?
Could not export safely in this format or the output is too large. Try JSON instead of TXT or copy.
Text copied. Paste into the official Lorebook Import editor.
Converted file saved. Select it in the official Lorebook Import editor.
Keywords, one per line (blank lines ignored)
Delete this entry from the local draft?
Keep at least one entry. Create a new lorebook to replace the draft.
Cannot save this edit within the local size limits. Existing draft kept.
Close this workspace? Unsaved changes will be lost unless you save a local draft or export a file.
Save as a new local copy
Local library operation failed. Check free space, file validity and the 16-book limit. Existing draft was kept.
Permanently delete this local saved copy? The currently open draft and exported files will not be deleted.

Keep identity, core personality and always-needed behavior in the Character Definition. Use lorebooks for facts needed only in context.

Entry ideas: side character, location, item, event, faction, system or rule, culture or religion, species. A useful entry explains how the fact should affect a reply. Choose specific names and phrases, not common words. Use at most eight activation keywords. {{user}} refers to the current Persona; {{char}} refers to the linked Character. Name a particular character directly if a shared rule is not true of every linked character.

Test in the official editor and in chat before publishing. Local saving does not link or publish a lorebook.

Prepare editable Character.AI fields locally from a new draft or JSON, PNG or CHARX card. CHARX import reads text only, not embedded assets. Copy fields into the official creator and save your draft locally. The original file is unchanged.

GitHub temporarily rate-limited requests. Try checking manually later.

Core Character.AI chat is free. Slow Mode and feature limits are controlled by the service, not the Companion renderer. If Charms are available, earn them through quests and use them to skip Slow Mode or ads. Choose an available free chat style. If a delay indicator is stuck, you can manually refresh the current chat from the menu. Save unsent text first and let any active reply finish. Refreshing does not guarantee removal of a server limit. Check service status manually. Companion drafts, dictation and local editors do not require a Character.AI subscription.
The service rate-limited requests (HTTP 429). Wait before trying again.
The service is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 503). Its original page is preserved.
Local draft, not synced to Character.AI. Save manually; saving empty text clears the slot. The clipboard is accessible to other apps. Unsaved changes may be lost when closing.
The local draft could not be read. Reset deletes the damaged file.
Paste relevant findings from external sources, or leave blank. Selected local fields will be included in the context. Do not include secrets.
Context is empty, invalid or exceeds 16,000 characters. Shorten the text or select fewer fields.
Review and edit before copying. Paste into the intended chat manually. The response depends on the model.
The selected search provider receives only this query. Local notes are not automatically added. Open results and copy relevant findings into the context.
Choose a unique character or story name. Names are matched without regard to case.
Local save. Up to 96 total records, 2,000 characters per record. Existing titles cannot be changed.
Check text, unique topic and available capacity.
Enter names, places or a topic. Exact word matching within the selected profile only.
Included: %1$d. Over budget: %2$d. Review context before copying.

Select at least one valid memory

The file contains all local memories from every profile in plaintext. Keep it somewhere safe. Import adds new entries without replacing existing ones. Character.AI account and chat history are not included.
Not enough memory bank capacity. Nothing changed.
New: %1$d. Duplicates: %2$d. Conflicts: %3$d. Existing entries will be kept. Continue?
Could not read backup or local memory. Nothing imported.
Only the entered query is sent to the selected Wikipedia language edition. Select and review excerpts before adding them to context. Do not enter secrets.
Request failed. Try again manually later.
Fill at least one field first
Save confirmed changes for this profile. Blank values are not saved; remove entries through Memory Bank. Fields occupy normal memory records.
Paste a conversation excerpt. Companion prepares a review prompt to copy into an AI model of your choice. Review its suggestions and update the fields manually. Do not paste secrets.
